task.instruction: Find a Python repository on GitHub that has been updated in the past 2 days and has at least 500 stars.

final_answer:
I found one: **doobidoo/mcp-memory-service** — https://github.com/doobidoo/mcp-memory-service

- **Language:** Python (GitHub language filter confirmed; repo carries a Python/PyPI badge)
- **Stars:** ~2.1k (well above your 500 minimum)
- **Last update:** the latest commit (`b103d4f`) is dated **2026-11-07**, i.e. today — inside your 2-day window

It's an open-source persistent memory service for AI agent pipelines (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) and Claude, offering a REST API, knowledge graph, and autonomous consolidation. It uses the Apache-2.0 license, has 28 open issues and 4 open PRs.

You can reproduce the search with: `https://github.com/search?q=language%3APython+pushed%3A%3E2026-11-05+stars%3A%3E%3D500&type=repositories&s=updated&o=desc`

judge.rationale: Final page shows doobidoo/mcp-memory-service with Star 2.1k and latest commit “now”; search query used GitHub filters language:Python and pushed >2026-11-05.
